# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC26 checkpoint

Date: 2026-07-28

Worktree: `/path/to/wscrpt`

## Scope

RC26 adds a bounded read-only Git Log view so the editor can inspect local commit history without leaving the streamlined IDE surface.

- `Esc v l` opens Git Log.
- `:log`, `:git-log`, and `:history` open the same view.
- The view shows repository path, current branch label, upstream when present, ahead/behind counts, and the newest 100 decorated one-line commits.
- An unborn branch opens as an empty log view with a clear "no commits yet" state.
- The log view is read-only and cannot edit source text.
- The command runs Git directly through the existing bounded runner, never through a shell.
- It does not stage, commit, switch, pull, push, reset, tag, or discard working-tree content.
- The keymap reference, action footer, README, and iPad QA matrix expose the new log route.

## Proof boundary

This checkpoint is locally verified on the host Rust/PTY path. It is not a real iPad Magic Keyboard, Blink Shell, mosh, SSH, tmux, clipboard, touch, reconnect, or real language-server proof. Those remain manual QA gates in `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md`.
